sample_selection: small_train_only; exactly one fitted row and one raw member per coordinate; sorted sessions round robin; sha256(raw-compatibility-v1:+position_hash) within session
sample_access: eight selected small-training rows only; no validation, consumed confirmation or August4 raw signals
average: arithmetic mean over all T repeats; no time selection
moving_average: source convention length51 ->48, width3, omit final possible window
fit: shared-width two-Gaussian; source initial values and bounds; scipy curve_fit trf, maxfev100000; one start
failures: retain every channel; no retry, imputation or stale coefficients; any invalid channel fails qualification
tolerance_basis: prospective numerical compatibility tolerances, not physical measurement uncertainty; per-element abs_error<=atol+rtol*abs(A); all192 elements required
pass_rule: 8of8 samples,64of64 valid channel fits,192of192 feature comparisons pass
pass_scope: sampled numerical compatibility only; no full lineage proof or acquisition-transfer performance claim
failure_action: close unchanged-model route; no tolerance tuning; any common raw pipeline requires new fair training approval
